page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.32xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The x86_64 architecture instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring reliance on external block storage for data persistence and operating system deployment. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The system operates with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring dedicated physical core allocation without hyperthreading.

Given the high memory density and dedicated CPU core allocation, the ecs.r7a.32xlarge offers resource density suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data processing tasks that require substantial RAM capacity without the need for local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
